title: First Vibration
summary: Before time begins, Light and Darkness emerge through a first vibration. Emotions arise as relational forces whose moral direction is not fixed, and humanity appears as the possibility of turning conflict into relationship.

links.note: The primordial Light anticipates the later Light Center without making the two strictly identical.
The primordial Darkness anticipates the later Dark Center without making the two strictly identical.
Humanity first appears as the possibility of transforming conflict into relationship, anticipating the Common Center.
